@syntax Goto label
Continues at the line after `.label`. The label has to be in the same function (or in the main program, when `Goto` is in the main program).

```blitzbasic
;run
n = 0
.again
n = n + 1
If n < 3 Then Goto again
Print n
```

```text
3
```
